plugin.description: Base plugin for every achievement and condition without pluginOverride

achievementName.description: Unique within the group; progress and the API key off it

pluginOverride.description: Defaults to the group's base plugin; conditions inherit it unless they set their own

icon.description: File name in Icons/<Group>/ (512x512 DDS, BC3 max)

notificationSound.description: Ignored when the MCM sound override is on

oneOf.title: Quest stage done
oneOf.description: Met when the quest's current stage compares true against the stage (>= by default).

oneOf.title: Player level
oneOf.description: Met when the player's level compares true against the level, checked on each level up.

oneOf.title: Skill level
oneOf.description: Met when the skill's level compares true against the level, checked on each skill increase.

oneOf.title: Item in inventory
oneOf.description: Met when the player holds at least this quantity of the item, checked whenever an item moves into their inventory.

formID.description: Map marker reference; takes precedence over locationID

oneOf.title: Location discovery
oneOf.description: Met when the player discovers a map marker, by reference or by name, optionally only in one worldspace.

oneOf.title: Dragon souls absorbed
oneOf.description: Met when the player has absorbed at least this many dragon souls.

oneOf.title: Player activation
oneOf.description: Met when the player activates the reference this many times.

oneOf.title: Spell cast
oneOf.description: Met when the player casts the spell this many times.

oneOf.title: Magic effect applied
oneOf.description: Met when the magic effect is applied to the player this many times.

oneOf.title: Faction rank
oneOf.description: Met when the player's rank in the faction is at least the rank. Rank 0 means any member. Checked when a menu closes.

oneOf.title: Item equipped
oneOf.description: Met when the player equips the item. Also met at once if it is already worn.

oneOf.title: First enter cell
oneOf.description: Met the first time the player enters the cell.

oneOf.title: Item crafted
oneOf.description: Met when the player crafts the item this many times.

oneOf.title: Book read
oneOf.description: Met when the player reads the book, matched by form ID or, failing that, by its displayed name.

oneOf.title: Actor death
oneOf.description: Met when this exact placed actor (reference) dies.

oneOf.title: Global variable state
oneOf.description: Met when the global variable's value compares true against the value (>= by default).

oneOf.title: Custom skill level
oneOf.description: Met when a Custom Skills Framework skill reaches the level. Needs that mod.

stat.description: Tracked stat name, as in the Stats menu

oneOf.title: Query stat value
oneOf.description: Met when a tracked stat from the Stats menu compares true against the value (>= by default).

oneOf.title: Papyrus variable
oneOf.description: Met when a Papyrus script variable on the reference equals the value. The script must be attached to the reference. Checked when a menu closes.

oneOf.title: Base actor death
oneOf.description: Met when this many actors of the base type die, matched by form ID, editor ID (needs powerofthree's Tweaks) or name.

oneOf.title: Spell learned
oneOf.description: Met when the player knows the spell.

oneOf.title: Location cleared
oneOf.description: Met when the location is marked cleared, checked as the Dungeons Cleared stat rises.

oneOf.title: Shout learned
oneOf.description: Met when the player has unlocked at least this many words of the shout.

oneOf.title: Quest objective done
oneOf.description: Met when the quest objective is completed.

group.description: Group file name; absent = this group

oneOf.title: Achievement unlocked
oneOf.description: Met when another achievement unlocks, in this group or another.

oneOf.title: Object state
oneOf.description: Met when the reference is enabled or disabled, as chosen.

oneOf.title: Papyrus binding
oneOf.description: Met only from Papyrus; carries no fields

oneOf.title: Player crime
oneOf.description: Met when the player's bounty is at least the threshold in every listed faction.

oneOf.title: Worldspace discovery
oneOf.description: Met when the player has discovered this many locations in the worldspace.

oneOf.title: Has perk
oneOf.description: Met when the player has the perk. Checked when a menu closes.

oneOf.title: Has perks
oneOf.description: Met when the player has at least this many of the listed perks. Checked when a menu closes.
